label: Connectivity
blurb: Areas important for wildlife movement now and under climate change (report Table 12).

charts.title: Connectivity and climate linkages
charts.subtitle: Share of each feature's extent in this area by conservation status (report Table 12)

method: Present-day connectivity categories are Cameron et al. (2022): channelized, intensified and diffuse. Climate linkages are Schloss et al. (2022): every pixel that is also a climate-change linkage under either climate model. South Coast Missing Linkages are Beier et al. (2006). Connectivity layers are fractional resolution-9 H3 cells and linkages resolution-8 presence, applied to the area's resolution-10 land cells. Channelized connectivity and the South Coast linkages are Key Features in the report: conservation of all remaining extent is recommended, so they get no need class.
